ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- if((typeOf(vars.salesforce_resp) as String) == "String") read(vars.salesforce_resp default "") else vars.salesforce_resp

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { esHabil: if((vars.headers.source != "WebChatEmpresas" and vars.headers.source != "WhatsappEmpresas") or (vars.salesforce_resp.esHabil == null)) "" else vars.salesforce_resp.esHabil, proximoDiaHabil: if((vars.headers.source != "WebChatEmpresas" and vars.headers.source != "WhatsappEmpresas") or (vars.salesforce_resp.proximoDiaHabil == null)) "" else vars.salesforce_resp.proximoDiaHabil }
